tools.name: virtual_stage_room
tools.description: Use only when the user wants furniture and decor added to an empty room. Ask only for the room image, room type, and design style when missing. Do not use this to restyle a furnished room.

tools.name: change_room_style
tools.description: Use only when the user wants a furnished room restyled while keeping its furniture arrangement. Ask only for the room image, room type, and design style when missing. Do not use this to furnish an empty room.

tools.name: declutter_room
tools.description: Use when the user wants clutter and visual mess removed while keeping the major furniture and architecture. This matches the Declutter Room workspace card.

tools.name: empty_room
tools.description: Use when the user wants all furniture, appliances, and decor removed so the room appears vacant. This matches the Empty Room workspace card.

tools.name: replace_furniture
tools.description: Use when the user wants one furniture item replaced with the item shown in a reference image. Ask for the room type and furniture item only when missing.

tools.name: replace_material
tools.description: Use when the user wants the material on a wall, floor, rug, curtain, countertop, backsplash, or another surface changed to match a reference image.

tools.name: render_interior
tools.description: Use when the user wants an interior sketch, model view, or design image turned into a photorealistic architectural render. Time of day and extra instructions are the only optional workspace controls.

tools.name: render_exterior
tools.description: Use when the user wants an exterior sketch, model view, or design image turned into a photorealistic architectural render. Time of day, season, landscape, and extra instructions match the workspace controls.

tools.name: custom_prompt
tools.description: Use for the workspace Custom Prompt mode when another named RoomLab mode does not match. The user may supply one main image, up to six reference images, and natural-language instructions.

tools.name: set_sky_blue
tools.description: Use when the user wants a dull or cloudy sky changed to a clear bright blue sky while preserving the property and landscaping.

tools.name: fill_and_clean_pool
tools.description: Use when the user wants a pool filled with clean water and the surrounding pool area tidied.

tools.name: clean_garden
tools.description: Use when the user wants weeds and debris removed so a garden or outdoor area looks neat and maintained.

tools.name: make_grass_greener
tools.description: Use when the user wants dry or patchy grass refreshed so the lawn looks green and healthy.

tools.name: visualize_wall_colors
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to compare paint colors on the walls of the same room. It returns a nine-color comparison. Color preferences are optional; use RoomLab’s balanced default palette when the user did not specify colors.

tools.name: create_video_walkthrough
tools.description: Use when the user wants one room photo animated with a camera move or other described effect. The effect and 5- or 10-second duration match the workspace controls.

tools.name: create_video_transition
tools.description: Use when the user wants an animated transformation from a start image to an end image. The transition style and 5- or 10-second duration match the workspace controls.

tools.name: create_house_tour
tools.description: Use when the user wants a cinematic tour made from three to six room images in order. The workspace offers an automatic or user-written script and 12-, 15-, or 30-second durations.

tools.name: upscale_room_image
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to make an existing RoomLab image 4K. The generation ID is enough; RoomLab retrieves the image and selects the correct upscale path internally.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check a RoomLab.app creation and return status or finished media as data, without opening another card. The existing creation card polls automatically. Use this tool when no card is available or the user asks to check a result; do not repeatedly poll alongside an active card.
